thread:
maria: Hey team, I started a docs PR to add a compact batching + cache prewarm cheatsheet for Optimize. It's mostly examples and a small decision table. Want quick eyes from ML infra and DevEx.

li: Nice. Can you summarize what the table covers so reviewers know what to look for?

maria: Sure  columns: workload type (short-prefix, long-stream, embeddings), recommended batch strategy (none / microbatch / continuous), cache prewarm (on/off/heuristic), quant profile compatibility notes. Also add a 'risk' column for latency tails.

owen: Please add concrete SDK snippets for both JS and Python for the three presets. Those are what users copy.

maria: Yup, snippet idea included. Example (JS):

```js
// short-prefix safe preset
await client.optimize.configure({
  model: 'redwood/q4-fast-v2',
  batching: {strategy: 'microbatch', maxBatchMs: 10},
  cache: {prefetch: false}
});
```

kayla: For Python, add the sample with explicit `prefetch=False` and show how to toggle `heuristic` at runtime. Also call out that q4_0 is fine with `prefetch: true` for long streams.

li: We should include a tiny note about tokenization variance across models; some tokenizers increase short-prefix token count which affects when batching kicks in. A one-liner will do.

maria: Good call. I'll add that. Also adding a tiny troubleshooting checklist: 1) turn off prefetch for q4_fast, 2) try microbatch 5-15ms, 3) re-run perf smoke.

owen: Can you link the perf job ID or attach sample numbers? Reviewers like numbers.

maria: Linking internal job 1991 with per-case numbers and a short csv artifact. Will attach to PR.

kayla: Label suggestions: `docs:optimize-cheatsheet`, `needs-ml-review`, `needs-devex` and `qa`. Mark as non-critical.

docs-bot: PR created: https://git.redwood/repo/docs/pull/3187 by maria  labels: docs:optimize-cheatsheet, needs-ml-review, needs-devex.

maria: Thanks bot. I'll add a small example dir `examples/optimize/batching-cheatsheet` with runnable scripts. Owen, can you add a one-line test that asserts no spikes > 250ms in the smoke run?

owen: Yep, I will add `tests/smoke/test_no_tail_spikes.py` and wire it to CI.

li: One more: include a sentence about tradeoffs: enabling prefetch increases throughput but can cause first-token jitter on grouped-attention quant profiles. Keep wording cautious.

maria: Will do. Plan: merge after 1 ML + 1 DevEx sign-off. ETA today if reviews are quick. I'll ping folks in the PR.

kayla: If it lands today, can we backport a tiny note to the Optimize v2 migration checklist? Some users read that first.

maria: Yep I'll add a changelog bullet and a backport note in the PR description.

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint passed, examples smoke job queued.

maria: Great  thanks all. I'll post a follow-up in #eng-ml with the merged link and cherry-pick instructions. :white_check_mark:
